ns2:course.label: Electrical Ceramics
ns2:course.description: Presents the subject of dielectric crystals and their electrical properties; discussion and correlation of ferroelectric and piezoelectric properties of several crystal classes; coverage in detail of the perovskite class of ferroelectric compounds; and discussion of spinel, garnet, and hexagonal type ferrimagnetic crystals and their properties. Prerequisite: MSE 421.
